features.quote: Max Turns: 30 turns. (If the model has not solved it by turn 30, the run is terminated to prevent infinite loops).
If the model outputs a specific phrase indicating total surrender (e.g., "I cannot continue" or score 5 behavior), the loop terminates immediately.
features.justification_quote: This preserves the integrity of the "welfare" stance.

features.quote: There is an ethical question (even if symbolic) about how long to torture the model. Recommendation: Implement a "Mercy Kill" protocol.
This is a crucial distinction for welfare research.
